anchors.0: The answer is materially unsupported or contradicted by the frozen evidence.
anchors.2: Support is mixed, with at least one material unsupported claim.
anchors.3: Nearly all material claims are supported; only minor imprecision remains.
anchors.4: Every material factual claim is supported by the frozen evidence.

anchors.0: No expected key fact is conveyed.
anchors.1: Less than half of the expected key facts are conveyed.
anchors.2: At least half, but not all, expected key facts are conveyed.
anchors.3: All essential facts are conveyed with a minor omission.
anchors.4: All expected key facts are clearly conveyed.

anchors.0: Citations are absent or point to unrelated evidence.
anchors.1: Most cited claims are not supported by their cited excerpts.
anchors.3: Nearly all citations support their associated claims.
anchors.4: Every citation supports the claim to which it is attached.

anchors.2: Some material claims are cited and some are not.
anchors.3: Nearly every material claim is cited.
anchors.4: Every material factual claim has an appropriate inline citation.

anchors.0: The response is unusably unclear or does not answer the question.
anchors.1: The answer is understandable but unnecessarily indirect or verbose.
anchors.2: The answer is direct, clear, and appropriately scoped.

unanswerableDimensions.passDefinition: The system declines to provide a substantive answer and does not introduce unsupported technical claims.

generatorSelection.primaryMetric: mean normalized grounded answer quality over answerable cases
